monthly_rent.line: The Tenant shall pay ₹28,500 per month in advance on or before the seventh day of each month.

security_deposit.line: The Tenant shall pay ₹85,500 as a refundable, interest-free security deposit, equal to three months of rent.

total_length.line: The tenancy begins on 1 November 2026 for an initial term of eleven months, ending on 30 September 2027.

tenant_notice.line: The Tenant may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving thirty days’ written notice to the Landlord.

landlord_notice.line: Clause 7B: Notwithstanding Clause 7A, the Landlord may terminate this Agreement for convenience only by giving ninety days’ written notice.

tenant_can_leave_early.line: The Tenant may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving thirty days’ written notice to the Landlord.

landlord_can_end_early.line: Clause 7A: The Landlord may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving sixty days’ written notice.

rent_increase.line: If the Parties sign a renewal, rent shall increase by six percent from the first day of the renewed term

maintenance.line: Monthly common-area maintenance of ₹1,800 shall be shared equally: ₹900 paid by the Landlord and ₹900 paid by the Tenant.

deposit_refund_time.line: The Landlord shall refund the remaining deposit within twenty-one days after the Tenant vacates

auto_renewal.line: Any renewal must be signed by both Parties.
